characters.name: Gutten (the Boy)
characters.prompt: A clever Norwegian boy from the 1400s, wearing simple homespun clothes, a small pouch for nuts at his waist, standing confidently with a mischievous smile

characters.name: Fanden (the Devil)
characters.prompt: A shape-shifting figure from Norwegian folklore, appearing in dark tattered robes, with a hint of horns and an unsettling grin, surrounded by an eerie glow

characters.name: Smeden (the Blacksmith)
characters.prompt: A strong, broad-shouldered Norwegian blacksmith from the olden days, wielding a large hammer, wearing a leather apron, standing in a rustic smithy

cleanedMainImagePrompt: An old Norwegian village backdrop in the 1400–1850 period, featuring a young boy holding a cracked nut, a faintly visible devil trapped within, and a large wooden smithy with a blacksmith poised to strike. The atmosphere should be dim, lit by warm lantern or forge light, highlighting the worn textures of the wooden buildings and rustic tools.
modernMainImagePrompt: A present-day rural Norwegian setting with a resourceful kid wearing casual clothes and sneakers, holding a slightly cracked nut containing a faint silhouette of a horned figure, while a modern blacksmith shop stands nearby with an electric power hammer ready. Capture the blend of modern technology with a hint of supernatural intrigue.
childMainImagePrompt: A bright, friendly Norwegian countryside scene where a playful child in colorful attire gently holds a magical nut. Inside the nut, a small funny-looking imp peeks out, more mischievous than scary. A kind blacksmith in a cozy workshop stands ready with a small hammer, ensuring the illustration is cheerful and not frightening for young children.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Et tradisjonelt norsk landskap med en ung gutt som holder en nøtt, med en liten figur inni som forestiller Fanden. En smed står i bakgrunnen i et lite smiehus, klar til å slå nøtten i stykker. Stemningen er rolig, tidsepoken er gammel, men språket er moderne norsk.
englishMainImagePrompt: A rustic Norwegian village scene from centuries past. A resourceful boy displays a cracked nut containing a miniature devil figure, while a rugged blacksmith stands by his anvil in a simple timber-left smithy, ready to strike. The ambience is dusk-lit, evoking the cunning, fantastical nature of the tale.
